info.name: Azure Blob Storage REST Append Blobs Azure Blob Storage REST API API

params.name: prefix
params.description: Filters results to return only containers whose names begin with the specified prefix.

params.name: marker
params.description: Continuation token for retrieving the next page of results. Returned in the NextMarker element of a previous response.

params.name: maxresults
params.description: Maximum number of containers to return in a single response. Defaults to 5000 if not specified.

params.name: include
params.description: Specifies additional datasets to include in the response such as metadata, deleted containers, or system containers.

items.docs: Returns a list of containers under the specified storage account. Results can be filtered by prefix and paginated using marker and maxresults parameters.
